Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

June 14th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that one of the monarchical party
named Yung Doo 楊度 has come to Shanghai and is now
staying in Hardoon's garden.
There is considerable unrest among the troops
at Woosung owing to a rumour that they would be disbanded.
General Yang has sent a telegram to Peking saying
that it is not necessary to keep so many troops in Shanghai.
A high military officer named Fong Kung Sung 方更生 has
been sent here to investigate the matter. There are about
three thousand Anwei troops stationed in the Doo Sz
Khoong Su 圖書館 outside the south gate at present.
The Central Government has ordered the Arsenal
to send 1,000 rifles to Peking. Chianchun Feng Kou Chang
has instructed the Director of the Arsenal to comply with
the order.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
（批：14/6 Auth）
Enclosed original. June 14.

16年6月15日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年6月14日

先生：

据报，君主派成员之一杨度（Yung Doo）已抵达上海，现寓居于哈同花园。

由于有传言称部队将被解散，吴淞驻军中出现相当程度的不安。

杨将军已向北京发送电报，称无需在上海保留如此多的部队。

一位名为方更生（Fong Kung Sung）的高级军官已被派往此处调查此事。目前约有三千名安威军（Anwei troops）驻扎在南门外的图书馆（Doo Sz Khoong Su）。

中央政府已命令兵工厂向北京运送1,000支步枪。姜春峰口长（Chianchun Feng Kou Chang）（原文不清/音译）已指示兵工厂总监遵照该命令执行。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警务处巡官。
（批注：6月14日 核准）
附原件。6月14日。
